title: Search common furniture surfaces when looking for newspapers
description: Use this when searching for newspapers or similar reading materials in a living room environment.
content: Newspapers are often found on sofas or other seating furniture rather than shelves or drawers. When searching for newspapers, prioritize checking sofas, armchairs, and similar surfaces before exploring storage furniture like shelves and drawers.

title: Handle failed pickup attempts by temporarily placing held items
description: Use this when a pickup action fails repeatedly despite the target object being visible.
content: If you cannot pick up a second object while already holding one, place the currently held item back onto a nearby surface first. This frees your inventory and allows the previously failing pickup action to succeed.

title: Transport items one at a time to the destination
description: Use this when moving multiple objects to a target location.
content: When moving multiple items to a destination, carry each item individually: pick up one item, go to the destination, place it there, then return for the next item. Verify your inventory is empty before picking up the next item to avoid conflicts.

title: Search closed storage containers systematically when looking for a target object
description: Use this when searching for an object that may be inside cabinets, drawers, or other closed containers.
content: When searching for a target object, open each closed container you encounter and check its contents before moving on. If a container is closed, you must open it to see what is inside; simply arriving at the container is not enough.

title: Heat objects with a microwave by placing them inside first
description: Use this when a task requires heating an object and a microwave is available.
content: To heat an object in a microwave, first open the microwave, move the object into it, and then use the heat action. Heating will only succeed when the object is actually inside the microwave; attempting to heat while holding the object or with the microwave closed will fail.

title: Complete multi-step tasks by finishing the heating step before moving to the destination
description: Use this when a task involves both heating an object and placing it at a target location.
content: After successfully heating an object, carry it to the destination and place it there. Do not attempt to place the object at the destination before confirming the heating step has succeeded.
